faqs.q: What is the DEMCO Series NE-D lightweight flange butterfly valve used for?
faqs.a: The DEMCO Series NE-D is a short-neck wafer butterfly valve with body notches that fit popular lightweight flange patterns, used on petroleum tank trucks, dry-bulk tankers and mobile blending units. It also self-centres in standard ASME Class 125/150 flanges, so one valve covers both.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the DEMCO NE-D come in?
faqs.a: It is available wafer-only from 2″ through 12″ (50 – 300 mm). Size-specific pages, such as the [4″ NE-D wafer valve](/p/demco-series-ne-d-wafer-butterfly-valve-4-inch-200-psi), list the factory trims.

faqs.q: What shut-off ratings does the DEMCO NE-D have?
faqs.a: It has three drop-tight ratings: 200 psi standard, 285 psi high-pressure and 50 psi low-torque, plus a throttling option. The body is rated ASME Class 150 at 285 psi non-shock and seals against vacuum to 10 microns.

faqs.q: What temperature range does the DEMCO NE-D cover?
faqs.a: The range is −30°F to +300°F (−34°C to +149°C), depending on the seat elastomer. Choose Buna-N, Viton or EPDM to suit the product, and the vented disc for extreme temperatures.

faqs.q: What materials does the DEMCO NE-D come in?
faqs.a: Bodies are ductile iron, PVF-coated ductile iron or ENC nickel-coated ductile iron, with 416 stainless, 316 stainless or Monel stems. Seats include Buna-N, Viton, EPDM, Hypalon and several neoprenes, and PVF-coated body and disc options suit hydrocarbon service.

faqs.q: What flanges does the DEMCO NE-D fit?
faqs.a: It fits lightweight flange patterns used in transportation and bulk handling, and also ASME Class 125/150 flanges, so mixed-fleet operators can use one part number. It is wafer-only and not rated for end-of-line service.

faqs.q: DEMCO NE-D or NE-I butterfly valve: which one for tank trucks?
faqs.a: The NE-D has body notches for lightweight tank-truck flange patterns, while the [NE-I short-neck valve](/p/demco-series-ne-i-short-neck-butterfly-valve-2-12) is the standard-installation valve for ASME flanges, in wafer and lug. Choose the NE-D for tank trucks and bulk handling.

faqs.q: Is the DEMCO NE-D fire-safe or NACE rated?
faqs.a: No. DEMCO NE-series valves are resilient-seated process butterfly valves without API 607 fire-safe or NACE MR0175 certification. Ask for a metal-seated valve where those are required.

faqs.q: What is the flow coefficient of the DEMCO NE-D?
faqs.a: The Cv at 90° open runs from 145 for the 2″ to 7,500 for the 12″. Use the figure for your size to calculate pressure drop.

faqs.q: Which operators fit the DEMCO NE-D?
faqs.a: Lever handles, worm-gear operators and Series DR pneumatic actuators; see the [10-position handle](/p/demco-10-position-locking-handle-for-butterfly-valves-2-12) and the [DR double-acting actuator](/p/demco-series-dr-double-acting-pneumatic-actuator-for-butterfly-valves-2-24). Add a worm-gear operator at 8″ and above.

The suffix reads left to right: body configuration (1 = wafer), body material (1 = ductile iron), stem (1 = 416 stainless steel), disc (5 = nickel-plated ductile iron) and seat (31 = Buna-N). faqs.q: What seat does the DEMCO NEI-T use?

faqs.q: What is the flow coefficient of the DEMCO NF-C?

faqs.q: Which valve sizes does the DEMCO square-nut handle fit?

faqs.q: How much torque can the square-nut operator deliver?

faqs.q: What is the DEMCO square-nut handle made of?

faqs.q: What is the DEMCO stem extension for butterfly valves used for?

faqs.q: What lengths can a DEMCO stem extension be made in?
faqs.a: Lengths from 3″ to 16 ft are fabricated to order. Lengths over 16 ft need a torsional-deflection review at the factory and are special order only.

faqs.q: Which valve sizes can a DEMCO stem extension be fitted to?
faqs.a: 2″ to 24″ (50 – 600 mm) on NE-C, NE-I, NE-I Sanitary, NE-D, NEI-T and NF-C valves; the 30″ and 36″ sizes need factory consultation. The 14″–24″ NF-C extensions use a different base part number.

faqs.q: What is the DEMCO stem extension made of?
faqs.a: Carbon-steel or stainless-steel parts in a tubular housing, with gaskets and O-rings sealing the stem extension at top and bottom. Say which material you need when you order.

faqs.q: Does the stem extension reduce torque?
faqs.a: No. It is a pass-through, develops no torque, and its stem is sized to the valve's rated operating torque. Size the operator for the valve, not the extension.

faqs.q: What mounts on a DEMCO stem extension?
faqs.a: The DEMCO top flange is at both ends, valve flange below and operator flange above, so a manual handle, a [worm-gear operator](/p/demco-worm-gear-operator-for-butterfly-valves-2-36) or a pneumatic actuator can sit on top.

faqs.q: What do I need to specify to order a DEMCO stem extension?
faqs.a: The valve series and size, the construction material and the exact length in inches (or feet for longer extensions). Lengths over 16 ft need a factory review before fabrication.

faqs.q: Stem extension or square-nut operator: how do I operate a buried valve?
faqs.a: A stem extension raises the operator to grade or a platform and carries any operator, while the [square-nut handle](/p/demco-square-nut-handle-for-butterfly-valves-2-12) is a T-key operator for buried service. They are often used together.

faqs.q: Where is the DEMCO stem extension used?
faqs.a: Wherever the operator must sit at a different elevation to the valve: tank-bottom valves, buried valves, valves in heavy insulation or cladding, and other inaccessible installations.

faqs.q: What sealing does the DEMCO stem extension have?
faqs.a: A tubular housing protects the shaft and provides bearing support, with gaskets and O-rings at top and bottom to stop fluid ingress. The listing gives no other rating.

faqs.q: Where is the DEMCO stem extension made and what lead time applies?

faqs.q: What is the DEMCO worm-gear operator for butterfly valves used for?
faqs.a: The DEMCO weatherproof worm-gear operator is the standard manual operator for 8″ and larger DEMCO butterfly valves, and is recommended on every NF-C valve from 14″ to 36″. It turns a manageable hand-wheel input into the high stem torque large valves need.

faqs.q: What gear ratios does the DEMCO worm-gear operator have?
faqs.a: Gear ratios run from 30:1 to 316:1 by valve size: 30:1 for 2″–6″, 48:1 for 8″–16″, 57:1 for 18″–20″, 60:1 for 24″, 316:1 for 30″ and 240:1 for 36″. DEMCO selects the ratio from the valve size you give.

faqs.q: What input torque does the DEMCO worm-gear operator need?
faqs.a: The listed input torques are 46 ft-lb for 2″–6″, 65 ft-lb for 8″–16″, 98 ft-lb for 18″–20″, 164 ft-lb for 24″, 104 ft-lb for 30″ and 174 ft-lb for 36″. The gearing is self-locking, so it holds the valve in any position.

faqs.q: Which valve sizes does the DEMCO worm-gear operator fit?
faqs.a: 2″ to 36″ (50 – 900 mm) across NE-C, NE-I, NE-I Sanitary, NE-D, NEI-T and NF-C valves, mounted directly on 2″–24″ and through a large-bore mounting kit on 30″–36″.

faqs.q: What is the DEMCO worm-gear operator made of?
faqs.a: A gray-iron weatherproof case and cover enclose a ductile-iron gear and a hardened-steel worm on bronze bearings, permanently lubricated. The standard coating is green enamel; white epoxy, coal-tar epoxy and inorganic-zinc primer are available on special order.

faqs.q: What input styles does the DEMCO worm-gear operator have?
faqs.a: Handwheel, chain-wheel, square-nut or crank. For chain-wheel input, the part number suffix is the chain length in feet, such as 4462-025 for 25 ft, and the chain is ordered separately.

faqs.q: How should a chain-wheel worm-gear operator be installed?
faqs.a: Mount the valve upside-down so there is pipe clearance and you can see the position indicator. Adjustment screws stop travel at the open and closed positions, and a position indicator is standard on every model.

faqs.q: DEMCO worm-gear operator or lever handle: which one do I need?
faqs.a: A lever handle is hand-operable on 2″–6″ valves, but DEMCO recommends the worm-gear operator at 8″ and larger. The [10-position handle](/p/demco-10-position-locking-handle-for-butterfly-valves-2-12) is for smaller valves.

faqs.q: Is the DEMCO worm-gear operator weatherproof?
faqs.a: Yes. It has a gray-iron weatherproof case and cover, permanently lubricated gearing for the life of the valve, and a position indicator on every model. Special coatings are available for offshore and buried service.

faqs.q: Where is a DEMCO worm-gear operator needed?
faqs.a: On 8″ and larger DEMCO butterfly valves and on every NF-C installation, including [the NF-C large-bore valve](/p/demco-series-nf-c-large-bore-butterfly-valve-14-36). It is also the usual choice on stem extensions.
